build_vqa_v1_dataset: run the build function to download and prepare the VQA-v1 dataset into the specified datapath
download_vqa_v1_resources: download the VQA-v1 Questions and Annotations zip files for train, val, and test splits
check_vqa_v1_built_status: check whether the VQA-v1 dataset has already been built in the given datapath directory
remove_outdated_vqa_v1_data: remove an older version of the VQA-v1 dataset directory before rebuilding
review_build_function: review the build function that downloads VQA-v1 MS COCO data and marks the directory as done
